comments.note: personas/standalone/src/meta/_shared.yaml: The standalone persona suite uses default_version: '1.0.0' as the generated version for all personas, even those with per-persona changelog entries (e.g. developer.yaml has 1.2.0, agents-md-curator.yaml has 1.2.1). The inconsistency means standalone changelogs are effectively decorative rather than driving the generated version field.
